key_idea: PDC(N,v) is the Eulerian number: inserting N into a permutation of N-1 either keeps the descent count (v+1 positions) or raises it by one (N-v positions).
sketch: Recurrence A(n,k) = (k+1)*A(n-1,k) + (n-k)*A(n-1,k-1) with A(1,0)=1, all modulo 1001113. Precompute the 100x100 table once and answer each query in O(1). Derivation: inserting n into one of the k descent gaps or at the end keeps the count (k+1 ways); inserting into any of the other n-k positions of a permutation with k-1 descents creates a new descent. Only pitfall is using 64-bit for the products before reduction.
